dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast off-white tips on median and greater coverts create segmented horizontal bands against dark brown feather bases.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp off-white boundaries visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where the uniform gray-brown crown meets the dark-centered, pale-fringed feathers of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial identification bands present on the right tarsus: one red plastic band and one metallic silver band.
